content_en:
Why Delta Homeowners Choose Whole House Renovation

Delta BC — comprising Tsawwassen, Ladner, and Tilbury — offers a unique mix of established neighbourhoods, newer subdivisions, and waterfront properties. Many homeowners here own detached single-family homes that are 30 to 50 years old and ready for a comprehensive update. A whole house renovation lets you modernize your layout, improve energy efficiency, and add the features your family actually uses day-to-day.

Unlike a kitchen-only or bathroom-only project, a whole house renovation addresses your entire home's needs in one coordinated scope. This means a single permit, one set of trades, and a unified construction schedule — often completed faster and at lower cost than doing the same work in phases over several years.

What a Whole House Renovation Covers in Delta

A full whole house renovation in Delta typically includes:

  • Kitchen renovation — new cabinets, countertops, appliances, and layout changes
  • Two or more bathroom renovations — master bath, main floor bath, or ensuite
  • Main floor refresh — flooring, trim, interior doors, and millwork
  • Electrical updates — new panel capacity, pot lights, and updated wiring
  • Plumbing modifications — if bathrooms are being relocated or reconfigured
  • Interior painting — entire home, all rooms
  • Lighting and hardware replacement throughout

Scope varies by property. A 1,800 sq ft 1970s rancher in Ladner with original kitchen and one bathroom gets a different scope than a 2,400 sq ft two-storey in Tsawwassen with four bedrooms and three bathrooms. Reno Stars scopes each project individually after an in-home consultation.

Real Delta Whole House Project: Kitchen + Two Bathrooms

One Delta renovation demonstrates the scale of work possible. This Tsawwassen whole house project included:

  • Kitchen — full demolition to studs, new custom cabinets, quartz countertops, apron-front farmhouse sink, and updated electrical for new appliances
  • Main bathroom — walk-in shower with frameless glass, new vanity, heated tile floor, and updated plumbing
  • Second bathroom — bathtub-to-shower conversion with custom tile work and new fixtures throughout
  • Main floor — new luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout, interior doors replaced, all trim and baseboards updated, full interior paint

The result transformed a dated 1980s layout into a modern open-plan main floor that works for both daily family life and entertaining.

Delta BC Renovation Costs: 2026 Data

Whole house renovation costs in Delta are shaped by property type, age of construction, and scope. Here is the typical cost structure for Delta homeowners:

Kitchen Renovation (Delta)

  • Cosmetic refresh (cabinet doors, hardware, countertops): $12,000–$22,000
  • Standard renovation (new cabinets, mid-range appliances, updated layout): $28,000–$45,000
  • Full custom renovation (premium appliances, custom cabinets, structural changes): $50,000–$90,000+

Bathroom Renovation (Delta, per bathroom)

  • Standard refresh (new vanity, tile, fixtures): $12,000–$18,000
  • Mid-range renovation (walk-in shower, heated floor, quality fixtures): $20,000–$35,000
  • Luxury master bath (curbless shower, freestanding tub, premium finishes): $40,000–$65,000+

Whole House Renovation (Delta — combined scope)

  • Light whole house (1-2 bathrooms, kitchen refresh, flooring and paint): $55,000–$85,000
  • Moderate whole house (2-3 bathrooms, full kitchen renovation, flooring, trim, electrical): $90,000–$150,000
  • Comprehensive whole house (all bathrooms, full kitchen, structural changes, premium finishes): $160,000–$280,000+

How Long Does a Whole House Renovation Take in Delta?

Project duration in Delta depends on scope and whether the work is done while you live in the home or you relocate temporarily:

  • Kitchen-only renovation: 4–8 weeks
  • Two-bathroom renovation: 5–9 weeks
  • Light whole house (kitchen + 2 bathrooms + flooring/paint): 10–16 weeks
  • Moderate whole house: 16–24 weeks
  • Comprehensive whole house: 24–40 weeks

For homeowners staying in the home during construction, Reno Stars phases the work so at least one functional bathroom and the kitchen remain usable at all times. Temporary kitchen setups — using a spare room or garage — are coordinated with each homeowner before work begins.

Tsawwassen vs Ladner vs Tilbury: Property Considerations

Each Delta neighbourhood has distinct property characteristics that affect renovation scope:

Tsawwassen

Tsawwassen's newer properties (built 1990s–2010s) often have more modern layouts and fewer structural issues. Older Tsawwassen homes (1970s–1980s) frequently have original poly-B plumbing, dated electrical panels (60-amp service in some homes), and kitchens that need complete gutting to open up to modern open-plan living. Tsawwassen's proximity to the US border also means some homeowners factor in international material sourcing options — though note that any materials brought in for professional installation must meet Canadian code standards.

Ladner

Ladner's established character means many homes are 40–60 years old. These properties often have good bones — solid construction from the post-war building boom — but need comprehensive electrical upgrades (60-amp to 100-amp or 200-amp panels), re-piping from poly-B to copper or PEX, and layout changes to open up closed floor plans. Ladner homeowners frequently combine a whole house renovation with a secondary suite conversion, given Delta's rental market.

Tilbury

Tilbury properties span a mix of older detached homes and newer townhouse complexes. Tilbury townhouses typically have smaller scopes — a full kitchen and bathroom renovation can be completed in 6–12 weeks — while detached homes follow similar patterns to Ladner and Tsawwassen. Tilbury's location near the Tilbury Industrial area means some homeowners use local contractors, which Reno Stars coordinates with alongside our own crews.

Permits in Delta for Whole House Renovation

Delta Municipality requires building permits for whole house renovations that involve:

  • Structural changes — removing or modifying walls, especially load-bearing walls
  • Bathroom relocations or new bathroom construction (even within existing footprint)
  • Electrical panel upgrades from 60-amp to 100-amp or 200-amp service
  • Any changes to plumbing — moving drains, adding new bathroom fixtures, or reconfiguring existing layout
  • Secondary suite creation or conversion of existing space to a suite

Delta's building department typically processes residential renovation permits within 2–4 weeks for standard projects. Reno Stars handles the full permit application process as part of our standard project management — no additional fee for permit coordination.

Financing a Whole House Renovation in Delta

Whole house renovations are significant investments. Delta homeowners typically fund them through:

  • Home equity line of credit (HELOC) — most common; access funds as work progresses
  • RCGT deductible renovation loan — Canadian government-backed; fixed rates
  • In-house financing through Reno Stars — structured payment schedule tied to project milestones
  • Refinance — some homeowners refinance their mortgage to access accumulated equity

Reno Stars provides a detailed budget breakdown and payment schedule during the consultation phase, so you know exactly what each milestone costs before work begins.

Choosing a Delta Whole House Renovation Contractor

Look for a contractor in Delta BC who:

  • Is based in or regularly works in Delta Municipality — Delta has specific bylaw requirements that contractors unfamiliar with the area may miss
  • Carries $5 million in commercial general liability (CGL) insurance — essential for whole house projects involving multiple trades
  • Has a valid BC builders licence and WSBC coverage for all workers on site
  • Provides detailed written contracts with fixed prices, not estimates that grow during construction
  • Offers a written warranty on all work — Reno Stars provides up to 3-year warranties on craftsmanship

Ask for references from whole house projects specifically. A contractor who has done excellent kitchen work may not have the project management capacity for a 20-week whole house scope that coordinates eight different trades simultaneously.

What to Expect Working with Reno Stars in Delta

Our process for Delta whole house projects:

  1. In-home consultation — We visit your property, assess the existing conditions, and discuss your goals, budget, and timeline
  2. Detailed proposal — Within 5 business days, you receive a full scope document with itemized pricing, not a ballpark estimate
  3. Permit coordination — We submit all permit applications and manage the municipality review process
  4. Project kickoff — Dedicated project manager introduced; all trades scheduled and coordinated
  5. Weekly updates — You receive a progress update each week with photos and milestone completion
  6. Final walkthrough — We do a complete inspection together before sign-off, addressing any punch list items
  7. Warranty period — 3-year craftsmanship warranty; direct contact line for any post-completion questions

FAQs: Whole House Renovation in Delta BC

faqs_en.q: How much does a whole house renovation cost in Delta BC?
faqs_en.a: Whole house renovation costs in Delta range from $55,000 for a light scope (kitchen refresh, two bathroom updates, flooring and paint) to $280,000+ for a comprehensive full renovation including structural changes, premium finishes, and all-new mechanical systems. The most common project range for Delta homeowners is $90,000–$150,000 for a moderate whole house scope covering a full kitchen renovation, two bathrooms, and main floor updates.

faqs_en.q: How long does a whole house renovation take in Delta?
faqs_en.a: A light whole house renovation in Delta takes 10–16 weeks. A moderate scope takes 16–24 weeks. A comprehensive full renovation takes 24–40 weeks. Most Delta homeowners choose to remain in the home during construction; Reno Stars phases the work to maintain at least one functional bathroom and kitchen at all times throughout the project.

faqs_en.q: Do I need a permit for a whole house renovation in Delta?
faqs_en.a: Yes — Delta Municipality requires building permits for whole house renovations that involve structural changes, bathroom relocations, electrical panel upgrades (60-amp to 100-amp or 200-amp service), plumbing modifications, or suite conversions. Reno Stars handles the full permit application and coordinates with Delta's building department at no additional charge.

faqs_en.q: Should I do a whole house renovation or add an extension in Delta?
faqs_en.a: An extension makes sense when you need more square footage — a new bedroom, a larger kitchen, or an additional bathroom that can't fit within the existing floor plan. A whole house renovation makes sense when your home has good bones but dated finishes, an inefficient layout, or systems that need updating. Many Delta homeowners do both: a whole house renovation on the existing structure, plus a targeted addition for the rooms they genuinely need more space.

faqs_en.q: What is the most expensive part of a whole house renovation?
faqs_en.a: The kitchen is almost always the most expensive single room — it has the most trades involved (cabinetry, countertops, plumbing, electrical, appliance installation) and the most material cost. Bathrooms are second. A typical whole house budget allocates roughly 35–40% to the kitchen, 25–30% to bathrooms, and the remaining 30–40% to flooring, paint, trim, electrical updates, and project management.

faqs_en.q: Can I live in my home during a whole house renovation?
faqs_en.a: Yes, most Delta homeowners do. Reno Stars phases the work to keep at least one bathroom and one kitchen functional at all times. We set up a temporary kitchen in a spare room or garage with a microwave, dorm-sized fridge, and hot plate. Full home vacate is only needed for specific structural phases that affect the only bathroom or kitchen. We'll coordinate this with you in the project planning phase.

为什么三角洲业主选择整屋装修

三角洲卑诗省（由 Tsawwassen、Ladner 和 Tilbury 组成）提供了成熟社区、全新住宅区和海滨物业的独特组合。这里的许多独立屋龄在 30 至 50 年之间，正准备进行全面翻新。整屋装修让您可以在一次协调的工程中现代化您的布局、提高能源效率，并添加您家人日常实际使用的功能。

与仅装修厨房或浴室不同，整屋装修在一个协调的范围内满足您整个家庭的需求。这意味着一张许可证、一组承包商和统一的施工时间表——通常比在未来几年内分阶段做同样的工作完成得更快、成本更低。

三角洲整屋装修包括什么

三角洲整屋装修通常包括：

  • 厨房装修——新橱柜、台面、电器和布局变更
  • 两个或多个浴室装修——主卧浴室、主层浴室或套间
  • 主层翻新——地板、踢脚线、室内门和木工
  • 电气更新——新配电盘容量、筒灯和更新布线
  • 管道修改——如果浴室需要搬迁或重新配置
  • 全屋室内油漆
  • 全屋照明和硬件更换

工程范围因物业而异。Ladner 一套 1,800 平方英尺的 1970 年代牧场风格住宅与 Tsawwassen 一套 2,400 平方英尺的两层住宅有不同的工程范围。Reno Stars 在上门咨询后单独为每个项目制定工程范围。

真实的三角洲整屋项目：厨房 + 两个浴室

一个三角洲装修项目展示了可能的工作规模。这个 Tsawwassen 整屋项目包括：

  • 厨房——完全拆除至框架、新定制橱柜、石英石台面、前置式农场水槽，以及新电器的更新电气
  • 主浴室——步入式淋浴间配无框玻璃、新洗手台、加热瓷砖地板和更新管道
  • 第二浴室——浴缸转淋浴间改造，配定制瓷砖工程和全新固定装置
  • 主层——全新豪华乙烯基塑料地板、 replacement interior doors、更新踢脚线和底板、全屋内墙涂料

结果将一个1980年代的过时布局转变为一个现代化的开放式主层，既适合日常家庭生活，也适合招待客人。

三角洲装修费用：2026 年数据

三角洲整屋装修费用受物业类型、建筑年龄和工程范围影响。以下是三角洲业主的典型成本结构：

厨房装修（三角洲）

  • Cosmetic refresh（橱柜门板、硬件、台面）：$12,000–$22,000
  • 标准装修（新橱柜、中档电器、更新布局）：$28,000–$45,000
  • 全定制装修（高端电器、定制橱柜、结构变更）：$50,000–$90,000+

浴室装修（三角洲，每间）

  • 标准翻新（新洗手台、瓷砖、固定装置）：$12,000–$18,000
  • 中档装修（步入式淋浴间、加热地板、优质固定装置）：$20,000–$35,000
  • 豪华主卧浴室（无障碍淋浴间、独立式浴缸、优质饰面）：$40,000–$65,000+

整屋装修（三角洲——综合范围）

  • 轻度整屋（1-2 间浴室、厨房翻新、地板和油漆）：$55,000–$85,000
  • 中度整屋（2-3 间浴室、全厨房装修、地板、踢脚线、电气）：$90,000–$150,000
  • 全面整屋（所有浴室、全厨房装修、结构变更、优质饰面）：$160,000–$280,000+

三角洲整屋装修需要多长时间？

三角洲项目持续时间取决于工程范围以及您在工作期间是住在家里还是临时搬迁：

  • 仅厨房装修：4–8 周
  • 两间浴室装修：5–9 周
  • 轻度整屋（厨房 + 2 间浴室 + 地板/油漆）：10–16 周
  • 中度整屋：16–24 周
  • 全面整屋：24–40 周

对于在施工期间住在家里的业主，Reno Stars 分阶段进行工作，以便始终保持至少一间可使用的浴室和厨房。在工作开始之前，我们会与每位业主协调临时厨房设置——使用备用房间或车库。

Tsawwassen vs Ladner vs Tilbury：物业注意事项

每个三角洲社区都有不同的物业特征，影响装修范围：

Tsawwassen

Tsawwassen 较新的物业（1990 年代至 2010 年代建造）通常有更现代的布局和更少的结构问题。较旧的 Tsawwassen 住宅（1970 年代至 1980 年代）通常有原始的 poly-B 管道、过时的配电盘（某些住宅为 60 安培服务），以及需要完全拆除才能打开现代开放式生活的厨房。Tsawwassen 靠近美国边境也意味着一些业主考虑国际材料采购选项——但请注意，任何用于专业安装的材料必须符合加拿大标准。

Ladner

Ladner 的成熟特色意味着许多房屋已有 40-60 年历史。这些物业通常有良好的骨架——战后建筑热潮的扎实建筑——但需要全面的电气升级（60 安培至 100 安培或 200 安培面板）、从 poly-B 到铜或 PEX 的管道重铺，以及关闭式平面图的布局变更。鉴于三角洲的租赁市场，Ladner 业主经常将整屋装修与次要套房转换相结合。

Tilbury

Tilbury 物业包括较旧的独立屋和较新的联排别墅综合体。Tilbury 联排别墅通常工程范围较小——完整的厨房和浴室装修可以在 6-12 周内完成——而独立屋则遵循与 Ladner 和 Tsawwassen 相似的模式。Tilbury 位于 Tilbury 工业区附近，这意味着一些业主使用当地承包商，Reno Stars 与我们自己的团队一起协调。

三角洲整屋装修许可证

三角洲市政府要求整屋装修需要建筑许可证：

  • 结构变更——拆除或修改墙壁，特别是承重墙
  • 浴室搬迁或新浴室建设（即使在现有占地面积内）
  • 电气面板升级（60 安培至 100 安培或 200 安培服务）
  • 任何管道变更——移动排水管、添加新浴室固定装置或重新配置现有布局
  • 次要套房的创建或现有空间转换为套房

三角洲建筑部门通常在 2-4 周内处理标准项目的住宅装修许可证。Reno Stars 作为我们标准项目管理的一部分处理完整的许可证申请流程——无需额外费用。

为三角洲整屋装修融资

整屋装修是重大投资。三角洲业主通常通过以下方式为装修提供资金：

  • 房屋净值信用额度（HELOC）——最常见；随着工作进展获取资金
  • RCGT 可扣除装修贷款——加拿大政府支持；固定利率
  • 通过 Reno Stars 内部融资——与项目里程碑挂钩的结构化付款计划
  • 重新融资——一些业主重新抵押贷款以获取累积的净值

Reno Stars 在咨询阶段提供详细的预算细分和付款计划，因此您在工作开始前确切知道每个里程碑的成本。

选择三角洲整屋装修承包商

在三角洲寻找承包商时应注意：

  • 总部位于或经常在三角洲市政府工作——三角洲有特定的小区细则要求，不熟悉该地区的承包商可能会忽略
  • 持有 500 万加元的商业一般责任保险（CGL）——对于涉及多个行业的整屋项目必不可少
  • 拥有有效的 BC 建筑商许可证和所有现场工人的 WSBC 保险
  • 提供带有固定价格的详细书面合同，而不是在施工过程中不断增长的估算
  • 对所有工作提供书面保修——Reno Stars 对工艺提供最长 3 年的保修

要求提供整屋项目的参考资料。一家在做厨房方面表现出色的承包商可能没有同时协调八个不同行业的项目管理能力来进行为期 20 周的整屋工程。

与 Reno Stars 在三角洲合作的方法

我们为三角洲整屋项目的流程：

  1. 上门咨询——我们访问您的物业，评估现有条件，并讨论您的目标、预算和时间表
  2. 详细方案——在 5 个工作日内，您收到完整的工程文件，其中包含详细定价，而不是粗略估计
  3. 许可证协调——我们提交所有许可证申请并管理与三角洲建筑部门的审查流程
  4. 项目启动——介绍专属项目经理；所有行业都已安排好并协调好
  5. 每周更新——您每周都会收到进度更新，包括照片和里程碑完成情况
  6. 最终检查——在签收之前，我们一起进行完整检查，解决任何缺陷项目
  7. 保修期——3 年工艺保修；任何完成后问题的直接联系渠道

常见问题：三角洲整屋装修

faqs_zh.q: 三角洲整屋装修要多少钱？
faqs_zh.a: 三角洲整屋装修费用范围从轻度工程（厨房翻新、两间浴室更新、地板和油漆）的 $55,000 到包括结构变更、优质饰面和全新机械系统的全面装修的 $280,000 以上。三角洲业主最常见的项目范围是 $90,000–$150,000，用于涵盖完整厨房装修、两间浴室和主层更新的中度整屋工程。

faqs_zh.q: 三角洲整屋装修需要多长时间？
faqs_zh.a: 三角洲轻度整屋装修需要 10-16 周。中度工程范围需要 16-24 周。全面装修需要 24-40 周。大多数三角洲业主选择在施工期间留在家中；Reno Stars 分阶段进行工作，以在整个项目期间始终保持至少一间可使用的浴室和厨房。

faqs_zh.q: 三角洲整屋装修需要许可证吗？
faqs_zh.a: 是的——三角洲市政府要求整屋装修需要建筑许可证，包括结构变更、浴室搬迁、电气面板升级（60 安培至 100 安培或 200 安培服务）、管道修改或套房转换。Reno Stars 处理完整的许可证申请，并与三角洲建筑部门协调，无需额外费用。

faqs_zh.q: 我应该在三角洲进行整屋装修还是扩建？
faqs_zh.a: 当您需要更多平方英尺时，扩建才有意义——一个新房卧室、更大的厨房或现有平面图内无法容纳的额外浴室。当您的房屋结构良好但饰面过时、布局效率低下或系统需要更新时，整屋装修才有意义。许多三角洲业主两者兼做：对现有建筑进行整屋装修，外加为您真正需要更多空间的房间进行有针对性的扩建。

faqs_zh.q: 整屋装修中最昂贵的部分是什么？
faqs_zh.a: 厨房几乎总是最昂贵的单个房间——它涉及最多的行业（橱柜、台面、管道、电气、电器安装），材料成本也最高。浴室位居第二。典型整屋预算分配大约 35-40% 用于厨房，25-30% 用于浴室，剩余 30-40% 用于地板、油漆、踢脚线、电气更新和项目管理。

faqs_zh.q: 我可以在整屋装修期间住在家里吗？
faqs_zh.a: 是的，大多数三角洲业主都会这样做。Reno Stars 分阶段进行工作，以始终保持至少一间可使用的浴室和一间厨房可用。我们在备用房间或车库中设置临时厨房，配有微波炉、小型冰箱和电磁炉。只有在影响唯一浴室或厨房的特定结构阶段才需要完全腾出房屋。我们将在项目规划阶段与您协调此事。
